messages:
Priya S: Quick poll for SFO layovers — who prefers airport ramen/bowl place vs. off-airport bodega/snack run? Trying to plan a quick meetup spot during the offsite.
Owen K: Ramen all the way. Warm, quick, and you can stand at the counter. saves me from bad airplane coffee.
Zoe L: Bodega/snack run if I'm on a tight budget. also more options for weird dietary stuff (GF bars, fruit).
Priya S: Good points. Also wondering: anyone want to caravan to the nearby farmer's market if we have a longer layover day? Good for local snacks and gifts.
Ken W: Farmer's market sounds lovely but tight schedules might kill it. maybe post-conference morning?
people-ops-bot: FYI: Reminder: Reimbursements for food during travel follow the per diem rules in travel policy. Save receipts and tag your expense with "offsite-food".
Priya S: Poll: react with ❤️ = Ramen/bowl, 💊 = Bodega/snacks, 👍 = Farmer's market detour, 🙌 = No preference.
Owen K: ❤️
Zoe L: 💊
Ken W: 👍
Priya S: Awesome, majority so far is ramen — I'll scout the concourse and post a meeting pin. If anyone needs to check luggage before exploring, DM me and I'll coordinate a quick drop-off option with Ops.
people-ops-bot: Event 'SF Offsite: Layover Meetups' added to calendar 2025-08-04
